extDescription.message: Show or hide each item in the Twitter (x.com) left menu and More menu, and each block in the right sidebar. Not affiliated with X Corp.

optionsSaved.message: Changes apply to open x.com tabs right away.

optionsDisclaimer.message: An independent add-on, not affiliated with X Corp.

layoutPromote.message: For each left menu item you hide, move one item from "More" into the left menu, top first

layoutWiden.message: Widen the timeline when every right sidebar block is hidden

noteWidenOff.message: When off, the right sidebar's space stays empty.

noteWidenWaiting.message: Takes effect only after every right sidebar block is hidden.

noteMoreNotSeen.message: Open "More" on x.com once and its items will appear here.

notRunYet.message: Not running on x.com yet. Open or reload an x.com tab to start. If nothing changes, check in about:addons that this add-on is allowed to run on x.com.
